description: Source code for the ADT7420 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading/writing registers, setting attributes, fetching samples, and device initialization.

methods.name: adt7420_temp_reg_read
methods.description: Reads temperature register from ADT7420 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: adt7420_temp_reg_write
methods.description: Writes temperature register to ADT7420 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: adt7420_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency and thresholds.

methods.name: adt7420_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a temperature sample from the sensor.

methods.name: adt7420_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest temperature sample as a sensor_value.

methods.name: adt7420_probe
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, verifies ID, and configures registers.

methods.name: adt7420_init
methods.description: Performs device initialization, including readiness check and probing.
